summary: The design direction sections 2-7 applied. The foot reads Line · Terminal · Search · Web · Log (no Kasandra); Line is the default and runs a Graphite line, an operation by name or an address; words for her are never run: the line offers "Ask Kasandra →" (first in the list under the line, a button at the line's end, the arrow's tip), which moves them into her column's ask line and sends them, where K4 makes them a plan. NET is the fifth meter (K8's state, a shape and a word, in each look's meter style, with a card), and the head no longer repeats it. workbench/state_words.py is the one table of state words and shapes (plus K8's NET states and A1's OPEN IN / OPENING IN / <PROGRAM> CLOSED), read by board tiles and wires, her column's steps, findings and state, the band, the dock and NET. One centre bar at every depth (Back, Forward, the breadcrumb; the board's counts and Whole desk at board depth; Board, Find, − +, Undo, Redo, Save, Save and Return, Full program, Split, Close at work depth; what a narrow centre cannot fit goes behind "More ▾"); the board draws no head of its own and the breadcrumb row is folded in. "Waits for you" under her hologram, only when something waits (a step that needs your word, grant or review; her one question), each with its one press; NEXT STEPS and the grants' fold no longer repeat it. Day is a fresh profile's look (an existing profile keeps its look). Empty and first states: the empty board shows Home with "Select something on the left; what it is connected to appears here."; a lone tile says "Nothing recorded links to it yet"; her column with no model says what she can still do and where her model is added (Brain room → Add file).

decisions: Enter in Line takes what the line offers first: a line runs (lines are read-only; an approve-scope operation still asks on its page); for words the first offer is Ask Kasandra →, so Enter gives them to her column. The 0.8.x rule "plain Enter never runs staC" no longer holds in Line, by the coordinator's acceptance ("a Graphite line typed in Line runs").
K4's objective reading comes first: "recheck the startup power" is hers even where a line could be read from it.
Ask Kasandra → moves the keyboard to her ask line after sending, so the talk goes on there.

A fresh profile = no session file at all: Day, and the new session keeps "appearance: day" from its first save; a session file without a saved look (a profile from before) keeps Graphite; an unreadable file keeps Graphite.

Her state under HALT is ‖ HELD (the table's "her work under HALT"), no longer ■ STOPPED; awaiting approval is ◆ NEEDS YOUR WORD; a step blocked on the network takes the blocked shape ▭ (⊘ is NET's offline).
REFUTED is drawn ⊘ on tiles (was a crossed square); the other tile marks were already the table's.

NET's word is drawn whole or not at all: on windows 1600 px and wider the meters reserve room for "offline" (both panes grow by about 60 px at 1920x1200); at 1366x768 NET shows its shape (word in its tip and card), so the panes and the centre keep their width. TXT, which has no reading source in this build, reserves only "TXT —".

The centre bar folds, least used first, Full program, Split, Save and Return, Undo+Redo, −+ behind "More ▾" (each a menu row with its words, enabled state and tip) when the centre is too narrow; nothing is lost. ‹ Field is hidden: Whole desk on the board is one press away, and the Field keeps its menus and keys. The Field's own "Board" corner button moved into the bar (map depth).
The name of what is open is the breadcrumb's last part; beside it the bar keeps only whether it is saved ("· not saved yet", "read only").

"Waits for you" carries Authorise step n, the grant (its words whole, always) and a review (press: Review it, its steps and journal); her one question when her hand waits on it. NEXT STEPS no longer repeats an Authorise or a grant; the grants' fold keeps only GRANTS [n] · see them; ACTIVE WORK no longer repeats a needs-review step's words.

Her column "squeezed" (compact, or something waits and her hologram leaves less than 800 px): the exchange gives way first (to a sliver at 1366 when several wait), findings fold to two, NEXT STEPS to two, ACTIVE WORK to one row; the band never folds.
The dock's Graphite entry adds her state only when it needs you (◆ NEEDS YOUR WORD, ‖ held, ▮▮ stopped by you).

At 1366x768 the centre is narrow: at work depth 5 to 7 controls are behind More ▾. P4/D2 may want icons for Save and Return and Split, or narrower panes.

not_done: The Field's own head (the whole desk, map depth) is left as it is: only the board's head and the bar above the work were folded into the one bar.
No colour or font restyling (section 9 is P4's).
Nothing was tested in the owner's sense, and nothing ran on the ThinkPad; no test suite, tiers or window checks were run.
release_note: The design direction, applied (the builder's design, at the owner's request): the foot is the computer's line, Line · Terminal · Search · Web · Log, with Line the default; words meant for Kasandra are offered with "Ask Kasandra →" and go to her column, where she plans them. NET joins CPU GPU RAM TXT at the foot. One centre bar at every depth (where you are, then the board's counts or the work's controls, the rest behind More when the window is narrow). "Waits for you" at the top of her column, only when something does, each with its one press. One language of states (word and shape) across tiles, wires, steps, her state, the dock and NET. Day is the look of a new profile. Empty states teach: Home and one line on an empty board; with no model, what she can still do and where her model is added.
